Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our dinner meeting scheduled for May 24, 2024, at 19:00 (7:00 PM) at The Gourmet Restaurant. The dinner is expected to run until 21:00 (9:00 PM).

Please let me know if this time works for you and if there are any changes needed on your end.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
